task: Increase pipeline phase label text size to fill the h-[240px] card properly

changes.rationale: text-px-sm is too small for the 240px card. With ~178px usable height after header and padding, 5 labels at text-px-lg (approx 18-20px) fill the space with comfortable breathing room.

changes.target: change parent flex from justify-between to gap-4 and remove justify-between
changes.rationale: justify-between on 5 items in a flex-1 container spreads them too thin at larger text sizes. gap-4 with flex-1 distributes space evenly and looks more intentional.
Slightly wider icon column keeps alignment clean at the larger text size.
